name: authority
wording: The factors saying what an agent may decide (decision-rights) and how far it acts before asking (autonomy). Per class of decision, sign-off at the operator's gates among them, it takes a RAPID part: decides, recommends, agrees, gives input or performs. Autonomy holds by scope: principal over what it decides; in the loop at a gate whose sign-off it does not hold, waiting for it; on the loop otherwise, acting while it can be overseen and stopped, between gates and at a gate whose sign-off the operator has delegated to it, where the operator is out of the loop of that sign-off yet can still stop the work, so no out-of-the-loop value exists. Between gates it escalates only a fork that is irreversible, about value, or beyond its competence.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
